summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, to publish an updated investors presentation on its website. The filing is a routine current report by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, furnishing the presentation as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, management change, or strategic review is disclosed. The presentation appears to be a standard corporate update with forward-looking statements and risks. This filing does not initiate or announce any special situation.
